admission.justification: A correctly selected skeleton can show stale counts, a correct bounded preview can lose complete content, and a current hydrated body can still be rendered by the wrong form; the three members jointly preserve document content/identity continuity.

guarantee: The model-selected fixed document page remains a truthful view of the same selected document across bounded summaries, complete-content own views and body hydration: fixed nonempty composition, whole-population counts and current summary-owned facts jointly survive navigation and revision changes. None of form composition, bounds or hydration alone ensures that continuity.
title: Fixed document-page content continuity
